title: A Ledger for the Confession Anew
author: Hazel Nystrom
blurb: Oscar Vane, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the statute expires.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
